title: Privacy
intro: Going Wild was made to be played with no account and no collection of personal data.

whatWeStore.title: What we keep
paragraphs: Your progress (phases won) and your settings are saved only on your device.
We don't ask for your name, email, location or contacts.

whatWeShare.title: What we share
paragraphs: Nothing. We don't sell or send your data to third parties.

deletingYourData.title: Deleting your data
paragraphs: Use "Reset progress" in the settings or uninstall the game.

contact.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about privacy: reach us through the email on the game's store page.
